game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Pilzez97
quote: 30fps, bland and dry voice acting, most amount of development time and least amount of innovation and creativity on a installation, pure slop that I can’t even pretend to like. Jason being a huge reason this falls so miserably short of expectations.
